definitions.explanation: arranged or occurring alongside each other, not in sequence
a circuit or process where components are connected side by side or operations happen simultaneously

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}を{並列|へいれつ}に{並|なら}べた。
examples.english: I arranged the desks side by side.

examples.japanese: {複数|ふくすう}の{作業|さぎょう}を{並列|へいれつ}で{進|すす}める。
examples.english: I work on multiple tasks in parallel.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{案|あん}を{並列|へいれつ}で{検討|けんとう}する。
examples.english: We'll consider two proposals in parallel.

examples.japanese: {並列|へいれつ}{回路|かいろ}では{電圧|でんあつ}が{同|おな}じになる。
examples.english: In a parallel circuit, the voltage is the same.

examples.japanese: {並列|へいれつ}{処理|しょり}で{計算|けいさん}{速度|そくど}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: Increase calculation speed with parallel processing.

examples.japanese: {並列|へいれつ}コンピューティングが{普及|ふきゅう}している。

notes:
FORMATION:
{並|へい} (line up, side by side) + {列|れつ} (row, column) → arranged side by side

VERB FORM:
{並列|へいれつ}する (to arrange in parallel)

ANTONYM:
{直列|ちょくれつ} (serial, in series)

TECHNICAL TERMS:
- {並列|へいれつ}{回路|かいろ} (parallel circuit)
- {並列|へいれつ}{処理|しょり} (parallel processing)
- {並列|へいれつ}{接続|せつぞく} (parallel connection)

COMPARISON:
- {並列|へいれつ}{回路|かいろ}: Components share voltage, current divides
- {直列|ちょくれつ}{回路|かいろ}: Components share current, voltage divides
